data.one_liner: A collection of utility extensions and specialized data structures for Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides collections, iterables extensions, graph theory algorithms, math and number types, caching strategies, and character matching tools. It complements the Dart standard library with extensively tested data structures and utilities.
use_when: You need advanced collection types like Multimaps, BiMaps, and BitLists.
You require graph-theory data structures and algorithms such as shortest pathing.
You want exact rational arithmetic, complex numbers, or math extensions on integers.
avoid_when: You only need basic collections already covered by dart:collection.
You want a fully-fledged state management library.
strengths: Extensively tested comprehensive set of utilities.
Includes specialized data structures and algorithms not found in core Dart.
Supports multiple libraries like caching, graph theory, and functional types.
weaknesses: Large assortment of disparate features may pull in more than needed if only a small utility is required.
